messages:
maria-ps: @ops-bot opening warroom — AcmeCorp reporting intermittent 502/504s and long-tail timeouts hitting hosted endpoint /v1/generate. High customer impact, started ~02:10 UTC.
ops-bot: incident created: INCIDENT-2026-2791 (warroom opened by maria-ps)
support-alex: customer says errors spike during their nightly batch run, includes request id req_9aC3... attached a curl. They see retries and then timeouts.
maria-ps: curl repro (from customer):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" 
  -H "X-Customer: acme" 
  -d '{"model":"gpt-large","input":"<big-batch>"}'
```
devin-sre: seeing a 5xx wave in eu-west ingress. Backend latency and upstream connection drops spike at the same times. KV cache miss rate +3x, queue depth rising on inference workers. Grafana snapshot posted.
sam-oncall: suggest temporary mitigation: route AcmeCorp traffic to fallback (smaller) model + lower circuit breaker threshold. Can push policy in next 2min.
jordan-eng: logs show interleaved 401s from auth proxy before 502s — billing/auth service throttles appear correlated. Pasting snippet: `auth-proxy: 401 refresh_token throttle` then `gateway: upstream timeout -> 504`.
lee-product: Customer is enterprise tier — prioritize mitigation and follow-up. Notify account team.
devin-sre: initiating small burst autoscale for hosted inference pool in eu-west; should add capacity in ~3m. Also collecting traces for affected req ids.
sam-oncall: applied routing change: AcmeCorp -> model-redwood-small fallback, circuit-breaker lowered 50->20. Monitoring now.
support-alex: told customer we switched them to fallback model and recommended retry backoff. They acknowledged and appreciate quick action.
maria-ps: early metrics: 502/504 rate for this tenant down ~70% since routing and circuit changes. p95 latency down from ~3.2s to ~1.1s.
devin-sre: hypothesis: auth proxy + billing throttles caused transient 401s which triggered client retries; retry storms amplified load, auth proxy hit connection limits, upstream timed out -> gateway 5xx. Need to harden auth backpressure.
jordan-eng: saved repro: run curl above with X-Customer: acme and payload ~10k tokens -> we reproduce 504 after ~15s. Full server trace attached to thread.
maria-ps: action items (assign):
  1) auth proxy backpressure fixes + queue limits (devin-sre)
  2) rate-limit/ingress retry damping for tenants (sam-oncall)
  3) update fallback routing runbook & templates (jordan-eng)
  4) customer comms + billing impact evaluation (support-alex)
  5) write postmortem and coordinate with account + SRE (lee-product)
devin-sre: taking #1 — will open PR to add queue cap + shed connections and instrument auth proxy metrics. ETA: 48h for PR, 7d for rollout.
sam-oncall: taking #2 — implement middleware to respect Retry-After and cap retries per tenant; will canary in eu-west first.
jordan-eng: taking #3 — update docs and add a toggle in routing config to enable fallback per-tenant.
support-alex: taking #4 — drafting customer note and checking refund eligibility; will sync with finance.
lee-product: owning #5 — will assemble timeline and draft postmortem. Postmortem draft due by EOD tomorrow.
ops-bot: note added: mitigation actions and assignments recorded in INCIDENT-2026-2791.
maria-ps: couple more observations: KV cache warmup seems poor for that tenant after failover; worth adding tenant-aware prewarming.
devin-sre: agree — add KV cache warmup for hot tenants to backlog. Also propose auto-tune for circuit-breaker thresholds based on token-bucket occupancy.
sam-oncall: keeping fallback routing active for 24h to validate stability, then re-evaluate.
support-alex: customer reporting steady behavior post-mitigation, will keep them updated every 2h.
maria-ps: thanks all. Closing warroom in 30m if metrics stay stable; will convert to postmortem follow-up thread and link incident.
